digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage LLM failure handling
propositions: Three defensive exception-handling arms in gate_dispatch and container_stage that handle LLM-tier failures have zero test coverage despite being reachable in production via the batch-runner path.

The plan-review mid-run exception arm (produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate) must handle both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError and degrade to INDETERMINATE verdict with sidecar emission.
The container_stage warm-call abort arm (inside _run_container) must raise on both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError without fan-out, abort on first model call only.
The code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract; upstream code translates and absorbs LLM errors before they reach this handler, making it non-reachable in current production paths.
New tests must demonstrate that reverting each arm's exception tuple to pre-43d4 form (LLMUnavailableError only) causes test failures, proving the LLMInputRejectedError branch is necessary.
